October 29, 2026


**Boston, MA – October 29, 2026 –** Flywire Corporation (Nasdaq: FLYW), a global payments enablement and software company, today announced that Liquidity Services Inc. (Nasdaq: LQDT) has implemented Flywire to run both domestic and cross-border B2B payments for the global e-commerce marketplace, with over $15 billion in total completed transactions


over the course of Liquidity Services International's 25 year history.


The Bethesda, Maryland-based company operates the world’s largest B2B marketplace for surplus and idle assets – spanning individual heavy equipment and fleet management to entire plant closures – for more than 6 million qualified buyers and 15,000 corporate and government sellers worldwide. A global force in sustainability, Liquidity Services Inc. helps maximize asset value and extend lifecycle utility, preventing operated assets from heading to landfills. This includes facilitating compliant and secure transactions for federal, state and local U.S. and Canadian government agencies.


For Liquidity Services Inc., Flywire provided expertise in collecting localized payments in complex corridors, successes that built confidence to deploy Flywire to run payments globally. With Flywire, Liquidity Services Inc. eliminates major roadblocks to expanding global sales by ensuring easy, secure and compliant global payment operations at scale. Some the benefits Liquidity Services Inc. has achieved include:


- **Localize the payment experience and expand payment options for buyers globally.** Buyers can use Flywire across 240+ countries and 140 currencies to securely pay online, using their currency and payment method of choice and a network with 1,200+ local payment methods.


- **Enable payment directly within the e-commerce portal.** Flywire is integrated via API with the Liquidity Services, Inc. customer portal for a seamless e-commerce payment experience, allowing customers to pay from anywhere in just a few clicks.


- **Eliminates manual reconciliation chaos.** Previously, reconciling payments across bank transfers, credit cards, and multiple vendors was a manual process. Now Flywire automates it across all payment methods and currencies, with consolidated reporting that saves the finance team hours daily.


- **Lower fees, faster payouts, and built-in compliance.** Flywire’s surcharging program saves on interchange costs while accelerating refund processing across payment methods. KYC is baked in, so compliance happens automatically.


"


*We are thrilled that Liquidity Services Inc. is realizing strong value from Flywire. Their story is exactly the type of problem Flywire is uniquely positioned to solve – offloading the complexity of collecting global payments and allowing a focus on the mission of their business* ,” said Ryan Frere, EVP & GM, of B2B at Flywire.


“


*Liquidity Services Inc. is on a mission to transform surplus from a burden into a value-added opportunity. And Flywire is a natural fit here. It has turned collecting cross-border payments – a burden on buyers and finance operations – into a growth opportunity* ,” said Kellie Twiss, Head of Product, Liquidity Services.


**About Flywire**


Flywire combines a global payments platform and vertical software to solve complex, high-friction financial workflows for businesses and organizations worldwide. Because complex payments and workflows require purpose-built infrastructure rather than a generic processor, Flywire provides multi-rail, regulated payment flows, deep integrations into clients’ core systems of record, and in-region expertise. Serving education, healthcare, travel, and B2B, Flywire embeds into mission-critical workflows, from tuition payment plans and patient billing to global travel transactions and invoice-to-cash, managing the full cycle from invoicing through settlement and reconciliation. Flywire supports more than 5,300 clients across 240+ countries and territories and is headquartered in Boston, MA, USA, with global offices. For more information, visit


[www.flywire.com](http://www.flywire.com/) . Follow Flywire on X, LinkedIn, and Facebook.


**About Liquidity Services, Inc**


Liquidity Services (NASDAQ:LQDT) is the leading global provider of e-commerce marketplaces and software solutions powering the circular economy with over $15 billion in completed transactions to more than six million qualified buyers and 15,000 corporate and government sellers worldwide. The company supports its clients' sustainability efforts by helping them extend the life of assets, prevent unnecessary waste and carbon emissions, and reduce the number of products headed to landfills.

## Why Flywire is partnering with Liquidity Services Inc.


What did Liquidity Services Inc. implement with Flywire?


Liquidity Services Inc. (Nasdaq: LQDT) implemented Flywire to process domestic and cross-border B2B payments for its global e-commerce marketplace. The company, which operates the world’s largest B2B marketplace for surplus and idle assets, has completed over $15 billion in transactions over its 25-year history.


How does Flywire simplify payment reconciliation for Liquidity Services?


Previously, reconciling payments across bank transfers, credit cards and multiple vendors was a manual process. Flywire automates reconciliation across all payment methods and currencies and provides consolidated reporting, which saves the finance team hours each day.


What cost and compliance benefits has Liquidity Services seen from Flywire?


Flywire’s surcharging program reduces interchange costs, lowering fees across the organization, and accelerates refund processing across payment methods. Know-your-customer (KYC) checks are built in, so compliance happens automatically.


How do buyers pay through Flywire on the Liquidity Services platform?


Buyers can pay across 240+ countries and 140 currencies, using their preferred currency and payment method from a network of 1,200+ local payment methods. Flywire is integrated via API into the Liquidity Services customer portal, so buyers can pay in just a few clicks.


Why did Liquidity Services choose Flywire for global payments?


Flywire first handled localized payments in complex corridors for Liquidity Services, and that success led the company to deploy Flywire for global payments. According to Kellie Twiss, Head of Product at Liquidity Services, Flywire turned cross-border payment collection from a burden into a growth opportunity.
